designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a medium lifecycle governor with 8 semantic usages, 21 typed interactions, 20 nontrivial cases, 7 scenario families, distributed qualification owners, one state owner, and explicit shutdown/recovery/fresh-request priority.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO forms expose the lifecycle owner's committed pre-state for state-dependent recovery without a same-evaluation algebraic cycle while preserving exactly 21 semantic interactions?
Can owner-local GUMBO contracts express the exact priority-ordered cases 07 through 17 and let the bounded analyzer demonstrate totality without downstream recomputation of credited owner facts?
Can EligibilityEnvelope, DecisionSnapshot, and PilotStatus be represented as finite structured concepts in the trusted tool subset without splitting or merging the declared semantic interactions?

model-review.summary: Add one uncredited support Process, raise raw node count to 9 and depth to 2, and retain the complete 8/21/20/7 semantic allocation.

findings.evidence: Retained focused-checker evidence rejects a behavioral Thread directly under a System and rejects compute_cases on a System implementation. Trusted Isolette and a freshly checked accepted medium source use System -> Process -> contract-bearing Thread and both return Well-formed with the current checker.
findings.requested_change: Add exactly one behavior-free generated-support GovernorProcess at depth 1, place PART-01 through PART-08 in it as Threads at depth 2, change both containment-depth selections to [2, 2], and change node_count to [9, 9]. Give the Process no PART, owner, state, contract, or semantic-usage credit.

findings.evidence: The 21 approved INTs can remain the semantic Process-boundary/Thread and Thread/Thread connections. Six inputs and four outputs require ten additional root-System/Process delegation declarations, so the minimal source has 31 PortConnection declarations even though the semantic edge metric remains 21.
findings.requested_change: Keep edge_count and semantic_interaction_count at 21 only as semantic metrics; report and trace the ten root delegation routes separately as generated support, and revise CONSTR-01, CONSTR-03, PASS-01, and matching design text accordingly.

findings.evidence: PART-02 maps four capacity/check pairs to three qualifications and PART-03 maps nine navigation/radio pairs to three qualifications with explicit precedence; both are many-to-one classifications rather than one-to-one enum renames.

PART-01 combines request, recovery, and charger facts under shutdown/recovery/fresh priority; PART-04 combines two qualifications, charger state, and lifecycle pre-state into applicability and recovery; PART-05 performs the sole state-dependent transition decision. Each has a meaningful owner-local relation.

PART-06 derives a two-output command pair with many-to-one and one-to-many distinctions, and PART-07 collapses five states into a one-versus-four authorization classification. Neither is extensionally outputCode == inputCode.

PART-08 earns ownership from precedence-based PilotNotice selection over decision and battery facts. Its next-state field is a copy and its five-way transition-result/disposition relation is a one-to-one rename, so those submappings do not independently earn owner credit.
findings.requested_change: In metrics and bounded ownership evidence, credit PART-08 specifically for PilotNotice derivation and do not cite the copied state or disposition rename as its owner-local fact.

findings.evidence: Current accepted syntax supports Thread-local state, In(state) pre-state publication, causally broken feedback, flat Data records with inspected attribute fields, and structured DataPort payloads; the 3,240 raw boundary/pre-state combinations are finite for a dependency-free analyzer.

designer-resolution.summary: Approved one support Process and ten delegation routes while retaining the 8/21/20/7 semantic baseline.

model-generation.summary: Repaired CASE-19 matches its DecisionNextState analyzer mirror, source traces use domain-relevant IDs, and the 8/21/20/7 model passes all gates.

visualization.summary: Validated 17-edge overview repairs INT-14 routing and passes native and complete traceability review.

designer-final.summary: Source-grounded 8/21/20/7 model passes bounded semantic and rendered-artifact review without owner padding or silent drift.

reason: Source-grounded 8/21/20/7 model passes bounded semantic and rendered-artifact review without owner padding or silent drift.
claim_boundary: Acceptance is limited to retained source/tool, bounded finite-analysis, trace, rendered-review, and Designer evidence. Deferred claims remain deferred.
